newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot products surge as NYMEX jumps sharply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot products surge as NYMEX jumps sharply.

text.p: U.S. spot refinery product prices surged higher by the close Thursday on the back of the sharp NYMEX rally, while differentials in New York Harbor (NYH) advanced slightly in modest activity.

Futures prices jumped higher on supply fears fueled by the continuing strike against the French oil giant Elf Aquitaine, as well as news of the explosion at Star's Convent, Louisiana refinery Wednesday evening.
However, cash market traders said the explosion at the Convent facility, which shut a 40,000 barrel per day H-oil unit, barely raised eyebrows in the physical markets.

NYH gasoline diffs moved up, with prompt M5 conventional gasoline barrels talked between 3.35 to 3.60 cents over the screen, with barrels for delivery on December 10 offered at 1.50 cents over the NYMEX.
Spot reformulated A5 87-octane gasoline was put between 6.50 and 6.75 cents over the screen, with delivery later in the month put at about 3.25 cents over.

U.S. Gulf gasoline M4 conventional gasoline diffs eased slightly, with front 35th cycle on the Colonial Pipeline barrels done at 3.10 cents under the screen, and back 35th cycle material talked at about 3.85 cents under.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
